models.mechanism: Recurring time acts as a press: succession compresses what occurs within it until latent consequences emerge as an extracted yield. The packet supplies the time, pressing, and yield images; their causal sequence is assigned, not stated.

activation_trace.assigned_role: the repeated duration in which the mechanism operates
the pressure exerted by temporal succession
the consequences made visible by that pressure

structural_cues: The single definite noun العصر concentrates the utterance on one polysemous root.
The terse oath-like By-time construction supplies no second lexeme to resolve the root toward neutral duration or an activated material image.

abductive_moves.assumption: Temporal recurrence pressures events and thereby exposes their yield.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: It turns the co-present B001, B002, and B007 branches into one functional process rather than a list of senses.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: recurring time -> pressure -> extracted consequence; every arrow is reader-supplied
alternatives: العصر denotes time without any pressing echo
pressing is only a lexical cousin with no role in the focus

changed_reading.before: A compact invocation of time as duration.
changed_reading.after: An invocation of time as an active press that forces hidden outcomes into view.

models.ablation: Removing B002 collapses the active pressure mechanism; removing B007 leaves pressure without an extracted outcome, returning the reading toward generic duration.

models.mechanism: Time is provisionally a holding chamber: it encloses and withholds latent life until a threshold of maturity, after which yield becomes available. The packet supplies enclosure, withholding, maturation, and yield; the ordered release cycle is abductively imposed.

activation_trace.assigned_role: protected latent potential inside the interval
the delay that prevents premature release
the threshold at which containment has completed its work
the eventual product released from latency

structural_cues: One root holds opposed branch-images of withholding (B006) and giving (B007).
B010 and B009 supply state images of enclosure and attained maturity, while B001 supplies recurrence; no explicit textual sequence orders them.

abductive_moves.assumption: Withholding preserves potential until maturity rather than merely depriving it.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: This assigns a productive function to the contrast between holding back and yielding.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: temporal enclosure -> protective withholding -> maturity -> yield; the packet supplies the nodes and the reader supplies the arrows
alternatives: withholding is harmful or miserly rather than protective
maturity and grain enclosure are unrelated dormant senses

changed_reading.after: Time is the interval that holds potential back until it can ripen into yield.

models.ablation: Removing B006 destroys the withholding function; removing both B009 and B010 removes the maturation logic, leaving only a generic time-to-yield association.

surprise_reading: At baseline, By time may invoke more than duration: time can be imagined either as a press that extracts consequences or as a chamber that withholds potential until it ripens. Both readings remain provisional because the focus contains no second root to select between them.
